# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.5

This prerelease hardens Shibumi's lifecycle, host compatibility, and release evidence without changing the established V1 or V2 visual design.

Update an existing source installation:

```bash
cd Shibumi-Shell
git pull --ff-only
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

> AUR publication remains pending because registration is currently unavailable.

## What changed

- Keep recovery journals and snapshots when rollback itself fails
- Restart at managed bar-owner repair boundaries instead of hot-reloading replaced providers
- Keep panel ownership and connector state independent across outputs
- Preserve the declarative bar visibility contract after layer-window recovery
- Restore Calendar, Power, Audio, and Network compatibility routes
- Keep third-party plugin updates behind Omarchy's changed-code review prompt
- Make baseline identity checks deterministic across supported locales
- Bind release promotion to checksummed, revision-specific lifecycle evidence

## Compatibility and release limits

- The suite remains 24 native Omarchy plugins in one Quickshell process
- No V1/V2 visual styling, geometry, typography, icon, or animation redesign is included
- Physical mixed-scale multi-monitor, enterprise Wi-Fi, and remaining device-backed Bluetooth checks remain explicit external gates

Full Changelog: [`v0.1.1-beta.4...v0.1.1-beta.5`](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.1-beta.4...v0.1.1-beta.5)
